'''Kamus Orden''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] for the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] until he defected to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Timely Arrival" />

==Biography==
At some point in his career as an [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] at [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]], Kamus came into possession of the documentation covering old expenses for a billion-credit [[Czerka Secret Weapons Division 7|research facility]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] working on a device of mass destruction. He decided to forward the documents to a Republic security office, and they caught attention of a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] agent [[Fauler]], who initiated a [[SIS operation on Tatooine|covert operation]] to uncover the mystery behind the facility.<ref name="Timely Arrival" />

Meanwhile, [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] found out that Kamus Orden stole their corporate documents and sent a strike team lead by an [[Unidentified Czerka strike team leader|unidentified officer]] to eliminate him. They found Kamus at the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] safehouse in the basement of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Embassy (Tatooine)|embassy]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], and were just about to execute him, when a Republic citizen looking for [[Fauler]] became an accidental witness and saved Kamus, killing [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] attackers. When Fauler arrived and the three introduced themselves, Fauler, seeing how the Republic citizen handled themselves in combat with Czerka, hired them to head into the desert and help with investigation of Czerka dealings.<ref name="Timely Arrival" />

Together with Fauler, Kamus later traveled to the [[SIS forward outpost|forward SIS base]] at the [[Outpost Salara|Salara Outpost]], where he stayed until the end of the [[SIS operation on Tatooine|operation]], helping with analyzing the data Fauler's new freelancer was collecting. With [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] defeated on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Fauler took him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where Kamus could testify against the corporation.<ref name="Thing Found">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|The Thing Czerka Found|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref> After the first day of his private testimony to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], Kamus wrote a letter to Fauler's associate, expressing his gratitude for their efforts.<ref name="mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Life after Czerka!|Kamus Orden}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Kamus was worried that if you failed, it'd mean the end of the world.|[[Fauler]]|<ref name="Thing Found" />}}
Kamus Orden, unlike Fauler, could not remain calm while [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] crisis had not yet been resolved. Eager to help, he was afraid of the dangers Czerka posed, from sending assassins for him to devastating Tatooine with their secret device. Kamus became especially concerned when he found out that [[Gayem Leksende]], with whose reputation he was familiar, was leading Czerka effort.<ref name="Timely Arrival" /> Being not very fond of the desert planet, he was anxious to leave, when the [[SIS operation on Tatooine|operation]] came to an end.<ref name="Thing Found" />

==Behind the scenes==
In MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Kamus Orden was voiced by [[Daran Norris]]. He appears in the Republic planetary quest chain of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
